review_scope: Existing GOFER 2019/2020 training and previously exposed 2021 development validation only; no new labels, domestic 2025 or test files accessed

source.attribution: Liu et al. (2025), GOFER v0.2, doi:10.5281/zenodo.14642378

observations: Outer held-period labels are excluded from inner candidate selection, calibration fitting and threshold fitting.
2021 is loaded after selected model/calibration/threshold fit receipt; prior exposure still prevents fresh-test interpretation.
17 events form only7 transitive overlapping78h metadata clusters; one cluster contains8 events.
Grouped nested CV is held-period generalization, not chronological future-only forecasting.
AP macro averages eligible event×horizon cells; zero-positive or all-positive cells are omitted, while Brier includes all nonempty cells.
The 80% threshold targets inner-OOF recall weighted1/n(event,h), not macro per-event recall and not future-event coverage.
Negative-distance scores are ranks, not probabilities; their Brier is undefined.
A common positive sigmoid preserves within-event ranking apart from finite precision; outer-fold-specific maps may change pooled ranking.
AFT versus selected classifier changes objective, weighting, features and hyperparameters together; improvement cannot be attributed solely to new features.
Dataset and direct trainer code are hashed; imported scoring code hash is additionally captured in this independent audit.

previous_aft_comparability.comparison_scope: 2021 only; AFT trained on all2019/2020 must not be compared as held-out nested training predictions

interpretation: AP improves on aggregate but event/period consistency must be considered separately.
Common 80% threshold is fitted using weighted inner-OOF positives across all horizons; horizon-specific and new-event recall are not guaranteed.
Distance is a ranking baseline, so Brier is null; raw and calibrated Brier can be compared directly.
Nested outer models were legacy_d2 for one fold and history_d2 for three; aggregate nested improvement is the entire selection procedure, not exclusively 35features.
2021 is previously exposed development validation and lacks independent operational validation.
The research outcome is first reconstructed perimeter approach within2km, not personal harm, actual flame arrival or domestic user-impact probability.
2021 event-horizon macro AP increased versus the older AFT, but pooled AP decreased at each of1/3/6h: improvement is not uniform across aggregations.
Raw and calibrated predictions produce identical frozen-threshold alert counts in both evaluations; calibration did not improve alert selection.
Some held event-horizon recalls fall below80%; the threshold goal is not an external coverage guarantee.
